text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone, eyes outside~. This is 
the venue for our "Overnight Experience 
Camp"!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Once you get off the bus, I'll show you to 
your rooms. Change into your gear and meet 
back in front of the camp lodge~!

Today marks the Tracen Academy "Overnight 
Experience Camp," held in place of the 
standard Open Campus!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't we show them the kind of 
strength you could never reach all on your 
own!"

And with that, she proposed this 
"Overnight Experience Camp." Prospective 
applicants stay at the camp lodge for two 
days and one night to experience academy 
life firsthand.

Having helped consult on the plan, I took 
on the role of supervisor. And joining us 
for this trial camp are—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo, welcome to the trial camp~! Let's 
have a super fun training camp together!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna teach you all kinds of stuff 
about Tracen Academy! Leave it to Turbo!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we're all classmates from the same 
year. We want this to be friendly and 
casual, so feel free to ask if you have 
any questions.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay! I'm number one!

text_block_list.name: Camp Participant A
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... So this is Teio-san's 
running...! Amazing, I felt like I 
couldn't keep up at all.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gnnnh, Turbo was winning at first! Teio, 
one more time! Let's race one more time!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hold your horses, it's my turn next, you 
know? Sorry, but whining won't make me 
hand it over~.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature, you stingy meanie! Fine, Turbo's 
just gonna join in and run anyway!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, do our future juniors wanna run 
again too? Chase after me and make me 
sweat!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
~♪ Let's try adding an arrangement right 
around here to match the tempo of the 
melody.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, those steps are truly like the 
morning dawn breeze so characteristic of 
you, Miracle-san. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I shall become the gentle south wind, 
delivering the dawn's radiance far and 
wide.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you two dance so gracefully. Slow 
tempos leave no room for faking it, so 
they're totally my weak spot...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to polish it—focus on your 
fingertips and toes. Just being conscious 
of them makes a world of difference.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Dancing together to grasp the rhythm is 
also an option. What do you think? Nature, 
dance with us for the next round.

text_block_list.name: Camp Participant B
text_block_list.text:
Wow, your meal is so healthy, Miracle-san! 
Do you always pay this much attention to 
diet?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with conditioning in mind. Nutrition 
and athletes are inseparable, after all.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Meals are part of training, but... fufu, 
it's partly personal preference too. I 
just happen to love natural foods.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Right. Nutritional balance is super 
important. Should I skip dessert and get 
some veggies instead...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Nature, wanna have pudding? I'm gonna 
eat one too, so let's eat together! Come 
on~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, the devil's whisper! You're just 
trying to drag me down with you, aren't 
you!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Well, middle and long-distance runners 
need stamina anyway... —Alright, I'll eat 
it! Turbo, you too!

text_block_list.name: Camp Participant B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she caved to temptation... Heheh, 
that's another fun way of doing things 
"together"!

text_block_list.name: Camp Participant A
text_block_list.text:
Phew~... This trial camp is so much fun! I 
never expected to have this great of a 
time!

text_block_list.name: Camp Participant B
text_block_list.text:
Me neither. I thought the atmosphere would 
be way more tense. Especially among rivals 
in the same class...

text_block_list.name: Camp Participant A
text_block_list.text:
But it wasn't like that at all. Watching 
all of you made me realize how wonderful 
having classmates really is!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hear that, Nature? Isn't that great! You 
know, it was actually Nature who came up 
with this whole trial camp!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You pitched your project to the Student 
Council President, begged Tazuna-san so we 
could use the training camp facilities, 
and called out to all of us.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You worked so hard because there was 
something you really wanted to tell 
everyone. That's why we wanted to help you 
out too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well~, when you see horse girls doing 
amazing in races, you can't help but feel 
anxious about whether you can really make 
it yourself, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But your classmates are your closest 
friends and your rivals. When you think 
'I'm not gonna lose to them!', it actually 
makes you stronger too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Since we're at the same academy, we get to 
see each other working super hard every 
single day...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it... like 'comrades in 
arms'? Hmm, there are just too many kinds 
of feelings involved, so it's kinda hard 
to put it into words.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A bond... maybe that's it. It becomes your 
strength, your support. I wanted you all 
to feel that at this trial camp.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Having classmates expands your 
possibilities. So come join us at Tracen 
Academy――!

The hope that Nice Nature presented. The 
future underclassmen gazed upon that light 
with eyes overflowing with anticipation――
